cases.name: Cancel material issue after finished receipt restores raw material without reversing finished goods
cases.expected: Reject cancellation once material issue has been capitalized into completed finished goods, or reverse dependent finished receipt first.

cases.name: Ordinary raw-material receipt accepts reserved sourceProductionOrderId and falsely clears WIP
cases.expected: Only internally created FINISHED_RECEIPT may reduce WIP; ordinary material receipt should leave this job WIP 2000.

cases.name: Backdated finished receipt posts stock before machine-cost recognition
cases.expected: Receipt and the cost it capitalizes must have consistent accounting dates. Historical154 must not become -3000 because machine cost is deferred to actual wall-clock acceptance date.

cases.name: Stopped BOM remains selectable for a new production job
cases.expected: A stopped BOM must not be selected for a new job (existing snapshots may remain).

cases.expected: Reject inactive product before creating a new production job.

cases.name: Concurrent metadata update reverts started production state
cases.expected: A successful start must not be reverted by a concurrent metadata-only PUT.

cases.name: Reopen completed service using future action date changes COGS of already locked period
cases.expected: Locked-period COGS must remain unchanged. A future-dated reopening should not delete the historical completion posting.
